workflows.name: Remove a member from a private project
expected_rules: The project owner can remove an assigned member.
After removal, the former member cannot read project data or private attachments.
Other authorized members retain their access.

workflows.name: Assign and complete a task
expected_rules: Only permitted project participants can assign tasks.
Task status persists after refresh and is visible to authorized participants.
Repeated submission must not create duplicate completion events.
